question: Should OpenClaw change `tools.loopDetection.enabled` from its current opt-in default to enabled-by-default for existing zero-config installations?
rationale: This changes an established configuration default and can cause previously permitted repeated tool calls to be warned on or blocked after upgrade; source and tests show that the present behavior is intentional enough to require owner confirmation.

options.title: Retain opt-in default
options.body: Keep the existing `false` default and address runaway-cost cases through the already-default unknown-tool guard or a separately designed non-breaking safety path.

options.title: Adopt enabled-by-default
options.body: Approve the behavioral change, then require matching type/docs/test updates plus fresh-install and upgrade evidence before merge.

recommendation.title: Retain opt-in default
recommendation.body: Keep the existing `false` default and address runaway-cost cases through the already-default unknown-tool guard or a separately designed non-breaking safety path.

likelyOwner.reason: The available feature history links this person to the original configurable loop-detection design.
